Profile Bergamot oil is a greenish or brownish-yellow volatile oil with a characteristic fragrant odour and a bitter aromatic taste, obtained by expression from the fresh peel of fruit of Citrus bergamia (Rutaceae). Constituents include linalyl acetate and 5-methoxy- psoralen (p.1607) and photosensitivity reactions have occurred following the topical use of preparations containing bergamot oil. Bergamot oil is used in perfumery and as a flavour in Earl Grey tea. It has been included in some preparations for upper respira- tory-tract disorders and hyperhidrosis. It is also used in aromath- erapy. ◊ Muscle cramps have been reported1 in a patient who drank up to 4 litres of ‘Earl Grey’ tea daily. 1. Finsterer J. Earl Grey tea intoxication.
